patches.title: Split fused tool-call arguments into separate calls
patches.symptom: Tool call "<name>": Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON at position N — Received arguments:\n{...}{...}
patches.rootCause: The relay can stream two tool calls into one index. @earendil-works/pi-ai parseToolCallArguments (dist/utils/json-parse.js) receives the concatenation, throws LlmError(MALFORMED_RESPONSE), and @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop re-throws because MALFORMED_RESPONSE is not in the default retryableCodes. Measured at dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1656 and confirmed upstream in deepseek-harness discussion #4427.
limits: cannot recover a call whose tail was cut by max-tokens (finish.reason.kind === length)
does not fix the relay or adapter that assigned one index to two calls
does not reorder or rename calls; the first call keeps the original id
cannot attribute which upstream stage glued the objects; it only sees the assembled text

patches.title: A rescue must be provable, attributable and atomic
patches.symptom: A call split out of fused arguments runs with an empty or wrong tool name, a repaired finish replays without replayState, or a block-end repair is committed before a later block of the same stream is rejected
patches.rootCause: Repair-stream used to commit each block-end repair as it arrived, kept only the last tool name seen on an index, and emitted {kind:"stop"} without the adapter replayState. None of these break the JSON proof, so P-0001 called them repaired while the runtime could still dispatch the wrong call.
limits: cannot prove the atomic-commit path live on this host: the measured adapter never emits block-end for a tool call
proves downstream acceptance of a synthesized block-start only on the finish path; an adapter that closes blocks itself is still unmeasured (BS-11)
treats a tool name that arrives twice with different values as unrepairable, so a legitimate adapter bug stays a failure
leaves the verdict vocabulary untouched: until P-0003 every rejection was counted as fused, so a non-fusion syntax error read as degraded (BS-12, closed by P-0003)

patches.title: A refusal must be observable, and a withdrawal must not read as a repair
patches.symptom: A stream whose only defect is plain bad JSON reports "repair incomplete" (degraded), and a proven repair that was withdrawn is indistinguishable from a fusion that could never be split
patches.rootCause: RemedyMonitor.recordRejected incremented fused and unrepaired for every rejection, whatever its code (packages/plugin/src/repair-stream.ts:122-126 in 0.2.0). A refusal that never proved a fusion therefore inflated fused, which both hid quiet streams behind degraded and erased the difference between "we declined" and "we could not". Left open as BS-12 because fixing it touches the verdict counters.
limits: does not change the four verdict states or their order: refused and withdrawn are reported, never judged
cannot express "observed, refused, and correctly not repaired" in a state name; only the counter row carries it
does not migrate old journal lines, which keep the six-field counter shape
proves refused and fused on the budget-refusal path only; a live stream that moves withdrawn is still unmeasured

patches.title: A bare value after a member key must be resealed, or refused — never guessed
patches.symptom: A tool call fails with `Unexpected token 'c'` or `Unexpected end of JSON input` because the model wrote a program, not a JSON string, after `"code":`; the turn is killed with MALFORMED_RESPONSE and nothing is repaired
patches.rootCause: The adapter assembles the argument text from deltas and hands it to JSON.parse. When the model emits a bare, unquoted multi-line blob as one member value, the text is neither a fusion (one object was intended) nor recoverable by splitting, so P-0001 refuses it as `single-object` and the call is never dispatched (packages/core/src/toolcall-repair.ts:124-141 in 0.3.1).
limits: reseals only when exactly one member value proves: two possible resealings is refused as ambiguous, never chosen
never touches a truncated call: a cut tail is missing bytes, not a missing quote
does not repair a duplicate key, a doubled colon, a missing closing brace, or an illegal escape: those are refusals by design
keeps the call id, so no synthetic identity is created and the stream budget is untouched
the ninth counter is optional in the type on purpose: a 0.3.x artifact has no `resealed` field and must render exactly as it did
